services.desc: Enjoy your morning coffee on the front porch while watching the blue heron across the water or settle into the comfy living room chairs and gaze out the large picture windows. This spacious country home has three bedrooms-two with queen-sized beds; one with a twin bed. There is also a daybed with a trundle in the upstairs center room. The bathroom has a separate shower and a tub/shower combination as well as double sinks. The Farmhouse is the very definition of charm in a place where nature blooms all around you.
